waterFilter: lake_name in ('BOW RIVER','ELBOW RIVER','GLENMORE RESERVOIR','BEARSPAW RESERVOIR','FISH CREEK','NOSE CREEK','WEST NOSE CREEK','AUBURN BAY LAKE','MAHOGANY LAKE','LAKE BONAVISTA','LAKE SUNDANCE','LAKE MIDNAPORE','ARBOUR LAKE','ASPEN WOODS LAKE','MCKENZIE LAKE')
simplification: Ramer-Douglas-Peucker, 3m tolerance for road lines and 1m tolerance for water rings in local equirectangular coordinates at 51 degrees latitude. Road endpoints, polygon closure, and MultiPolygon parts retained. Coordinates then rounded to six decimal places. Cartographic display only. Raw source files retained separately.
